walkthrough: This lab covers cloud networking concepts including virtual networks, peering, and hybrid connectivity.
Identify cloud service providers and virtual network components

Establish virtual network peering or equivalent connectivity
Configure hybrid connectivity (VPN, Direct Connect, etc.) to on-premises networks
Implement load balancing and auto-scaling groups
Verify cloud network connectivity and security policies
Test application deployment and connectivity in cloud environment
Troubleshoot cloud networking issues by checking routing and firewall rules
Save configurations and verify cloud network operation
